dedupe_keys.name: epri smart grid resource center use case repository

description: The EPRI Use Case Repository in the Smart Grid Resource Center is a collection of smart grid use cases and requirements developed within the industry and through EPRI's smart grid demonstration initiative. The page read on 2026-09-26 lists 185 use cases browsable by category (customer service, distributed energy resources, distribution operations, federated system management functions, market operations, microgrid and transmission operations), with files of a few hundred kilobytes to a few megabytes published mostly in 2010 and 2012, such as adaptive transmission line protection, advanced distribution automation with distributed energy, and a series from AEP on metering, community energy storage, volt-VAR control and outage management. Users can upload use cases in the IntelliGrid template. Coverage is mainly US utility practice. Access is free under EPRI's supplementary terms and conditions for the repository, which describe its educational and information sharing purpose. Caveats: most use cases date from the early 2010s and are narrative requirement documents, not data tables. Simulation uses are defining functions, information flows and control actions for digital twin and co-simulation models of smart grids, and for resilience studies of automation and outage management. Related records: data-ieee-pes-distribution-test-feeders supply networks on which such functions are simulated, and data-certs-microgrid-test-bed documents a microgrid test facility.
